title: ICD-10 code lookup from HIS master & validation

test_cases.name: Valid ICD-10 code verification
test_cases.input_setup: Validate code 'J18.9' against HIS ICD-10 master validator
test_cases.expected_result: is_valid is True with accurate description ('Pneumonia, unspecified') and EXACT_MATCH tier
test_cases.evidence: Code J18.9 validated: canonical=J18.9, tier=EXACT_MATCH, description='Pneumonia, unspecified'

test_cases.name: Invalid ICD-10 code rejection
test_cases.expected_result: is_valid is False, tier is UNRESOLVED, rejection_reason set
test_cases.evidence: Invalid code ZZZ.999 classified as invalid with reason 'CODE_NOT_FOUND_IN_HIS_MASTER'

test_cases.name: Batch ICD-10 validation latency bound
test_cases.expected_result: All validated accurately with cumulative latency < 500 ms
test_cases.evidence: Batch validation of 10 codes executed in 0.14ms < 500ms (all 10 valid)

test_cases.name: ICD-10 code case-insensitivity
test_cases.expected_result: Both normalize to uppercase 'J18.9' with identical valid status
test_cases.evidence: Case-insensitivity verified: lowercase 'j18.9' normalized to canonical 'J18.9'

test_cases.name: HIS code master file integrity
test_cases.input_setup: Check total code dictionary size from Australian ICD master
test_cases.expected_result: >= 10,000 valid codes loaded cleanly without syntax errors
test_cases.evidence: HIS master file integrity verified: 16953 codes indexed with zero parse errors
